paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.05% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.46%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.06%). Brent crude changed -1.25% to 88.25. Gold changed -0.82% to 3,621.5. Bitcoin changed -2.18% to 59,875.7383. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.912%, a relative move of -0.12%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-4.63%) and Glencore (-3.57%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Ousted BP chair Albert Manifold to join Aggreko board after IPO (FT Markets). Manifold responds to bullying allegations levelled against him and calls them ‘lies’ Deals and capital markets: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $44bn deal as cyber threats mount (FT Companies). All-stock acquisition comes as businesses and governments across the world grapple with wave of tech outages Central banks and macro: Top Fed official probed over whether she breached ‘blackout period’ (FT World). Michelle Bowman spoke at an invitation-only Bank of America dinner just hours after a central bank meeting Geopolitics and trade: Banks regain some ground in the private credit tug of war (FT World). For borrowers, the coexistence of bank and non-bank lenders is creating a window of opporunity Geopolitics and trade: Inside the ‘war room’ that lobbied Trump to bring back Jensen Huang (FT Home). Silicon Valley titans enlisted US president and JD Vance to rescue the billionaire tech boss whom they viewed as critical for the AI industry
